team.name: tier3-team-30
resource_msg:
**Your Team Project:**
 As a Tier 3 team you have the choice of building **_GitHub PR Review Board_**, an app to provide you and your team with status about your Pull Requests. All teams are required to create this same application from these [requirements & specifications](https://github.com/chingu-voyages/voyage-project-pr-status). **OR** creating an app of your own design. 

 If you choose to create your own you'll want to start by working together to choose a project theme, create a vision statement, and then build a prioritized list of user features.

This will give you what you need to build the Project Backlog you'll be following to design, build, test, & deploy it.
If you have a question or need help open a support ticket in the <#1193342042080817323> channel. Please do not DM Admins directly.

team_greeting1:
:rocket: **_Congratulations Voyagers!_** You found your team chat! Read carefully below so you don't miss out on getting a good start.

**__Your First Steps__** 
1. Say "hi" to your team-mates! Come in excited and help welcome your teammates! You can find a list of who is in your team in the Team Info topic in this channel. :slight_smile:
2. **_Copy_** the intro you added in https://discord.com/channels/330284646283608064/553103063649353738 when you joined Chingu and **_paste it here_** to let your teammates get to know you!
3. Follow the steps in the [Voyage section of the Handbook](https://tinyurl.com/283d482e) we emailed last week to set a solid foundation for your project. The most important step to concentrate on is scheduling your Team Kickoff meeting as soon as possible.

**__In your first Sprint you should concentrate on completing these tasks:__**
1. Meet your team & schedule kickoff meeting
2. Conduct kickoff meeting
3. Choose a project (Tier 3 only)
4. create a Vision Statement  & define & prioritize MVP features

**__How can we communicate & collaborate with one another?__**
We've created a simple and easy way to create a voice/video channel for team meetings, one-on-one discussions, & troubleshooting sessions whenever you need them. Check out the [How do I make a voice channel for my team?](https://tinyurl.com/28ayudc5) topic in the Handbook.

**__How can I get the attention of my teammates?__**
You should use <@&1104544072347160578> to send a message to all teammates instead of using `@everyone`.

**__What if I have questions or need help?__**
Please *do not* DM Chingu Admins directly if you have a question or need help. Instead, open a support ticket in the <#1193342042080817323> channel and the first available Admin will reach out to help.
team_greeting2:
**__Finally__**
Stay committed to your Voyage goal and active with your team! Don't forget what you agreed to in the Confirmation Form. Remember that the #1 factor to success isn't technology - it's **_daily_** communication & collaboration with your teammates.
